Ben (CSM): ApexCare asked for an evening enablement sprint next Wed to accommodate their APAC folks and avoid impacting production. They want a compact agenda: 90m infra lab, 45m PM demo, 30m office hours. Can we staff and confirm prereqs?

Renee (CS Ops): Evening OK from ops. Which timezone?

Lina (ApexCare): Primary team is SGT (Singapore). Best slot would be Wed 18:30-21:15 SGT (which is morning US PT).

Ben (CSM): Proposed Redwood staffing: Sam (trainer) leads lab, Ike (eng) handles sandbox & tokens, Renee coordinates invites.

Sam (Trainer): I can run the lab. Draft agenda: intro 10m, infra deep-dive 20m, paired lab 60m, perf + security 30m, wrap 5m. Need sandbox per pair and short prework video.

Ike (Eng): I can provision sandboxes (no SSH, container sessions). Will preload dataset "apex-telemetry-v1" and pin variant `gptx-3.7-lite`. ETA Tue EOD. Token template: apex_user_{n}.

Renee (CS Ops): I'll send tentative invites now (subject: "ApexCare: Evening enablement sprint") and flip to confirmed after Ike signals ready. Recording enabled.

Lina (ApexCare): Headcount: workshop = 8 infra, PM demo = 6, office hours = 4. Please add a short item on data handling and KMS. Renewal review references latency improvements.

Sam (Trainer): Adding a 10m KMS & data handling note and a 15m perf dashboard walkthrough to capture baseline numbers for renewal materials.

Ike (Eng): Sandbox provisioned. Endpoint: https://sandbox.apex.redwood; temp creds DM'd to Lina.

Renee (CS Ops): Invites updated to "confirmed". Calendar: Wed 18:30-21:15 SGT. Zoom link in invite.

Lina (ApexCare): Got creds and invites. Thank you all! Please include recording for folks who cannot attend.

Ben (CSM): I'll prepare a post-session playbook and metric sheet for renewal. Closing loop  ping here for any last-minute changes.
